description: Natural water balance of Qatar’s aquifers (Annual average 2014-2021) is a data set listed in Qatar Open Data Portal (data.gov.qa), an open data portal (Opendatasoft), published or maintained by National Planning Council. This dataset presents key water balance indicators for Qatar, including recharge of aquifers and other water resources data, measured in million cubic meters per year. Coverage: Qatar. The portal files it under the publisher National Planning Council. Its tags are water balance, rainfall, aquifers. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal shows 2026-04-28 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water resources and water supply network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-qa-portal.
